Name: Diverse Stardew Valley Flower Queen's Crown - Always Raining in the Valley (DSV ARV)
Author: AirynS
AuthorLabel: Airyn HimeTarts and the DSV Team
Description:
[b][size=4][center][/center][/size][center][size=5]﻿﻿Diverse Stardew Valley Flower Queen's Crown Pack - Always Raining in the Valley[/size][/center]
[/b]
[left][size=3]This add-on pack adds compatibility between [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]﻿'s Flower Queen's Crown feature and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9999]Always Raining in the Valley[/url]﻿'s NPCs Sterling, Mia, and Henry. If this pack is installed and Flower Queen's Crown is enabled in DSV's configuration menu, then Sterling, Mia, and Henry will have a chance of being chosen as the Flower Queen! Comes with custom artwork and custom dialogue for the three plus a number of vanilla NPCs related to an ARV NPC becoming Flower Queen.[/size]

[size=3][size=3][size=3][/size][img]https://imgur.com/0R7biKQ.png[/img]﻿

[size=3]This mod requires [size=3][size=3][size=3][url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/470174-content-patcher]Content Patcher[/url][/size][/size][/size] and the SMAPI modding framework; if you have not installed SMAPI before, see the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]Stardew Valley Wiki's guide[/url] for instructions.

It also requires [size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley - Seasonal Outfits[/url]﻿ [/size]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9999]Always Raining in the Valley[/url]﻿.[/size][/size][/size]

[size=3][size=3][size=3][/size]
[img]https://imgur.com/v0kYolw.png[/img]﻿

[size=3]In order to use this add-on pack, you will need to configure DSV Core so that Flower Queen's Crown (FQC) is set to "true". [/size][/size][/size][size=3][size=3][size=3]

The easiest way to do this is with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] mod. GMCM adds a small cog-shaped button to the lower-left corner of the Stardew Valley title screen, which allows you to edit config options in-game via an easy-to-use interface with either check boxes or scrollable drop-down menus. Once GMCM is downloaded and installed, DSV will automatically detect it and become available for configuration from the title screen. Please refer to the [url=https://diversestardewvalley.weebly.com/index.html]Diverse Stardew Valley website[/url] for a visual guide to the various options available.[/size][/size][/size]

DSV Core also has an option for FQC Immersion Mode, which restricts custom NPCs from becoming Flower Queen until at least Year 2. DSV FQC - ARV is compatible with Immersion Mode and can be used with it set to either true or false. For more details on Immersion Mode, see the DSV website.[size=3]


[img]https://imgur.com/EirFN0t.png[/img]﻿
[/size]
[size=3]This pack can be used as an example template for other custom NPCs to be added as Flower Queen candidates. Anyone is welcome to create their own add-on pack as long as they have permission from the original character author, both the original character author and the DSV Team are credited appropriately, and Donation Points are either disabled or donated to charity. See the [url=https://diversestardewvalley.weebly.com/adding-compatibility.html]Flower Queen's Crown [/url]﻿section of Adding Compatibility on the DSV website for a detailed explanation of how to create a FQC add-on pack.
[/size][/left][size=3]A copy of the Flower Queen's crown for portrait and sprite with a transparent background is available in the Optional Files section of this page as a template and mod creators are welcome to modify it as needed to fit their character. The design of the crown should be kept the same though.

[/size][img]https://imgur.com/t8cZCav.png[/img]﻿
